# E20 — Shaftesbury Capital plc

Retrieved: 2026-08-11. Listing used: LSE primary (LON:SHC). REIT (London West End real estate --
Covent Garden, Carnaby, Seven Dials) -- no inventory/cost-of-revenue concept applies. This entity
is UK-domiciled and UK-focused; included in Syn Bank's JSE-listed portfolio via a secondary/dual
JSE listing (JSE:SHC) not separately covered by this aggregator's URL scheme -- same consolidated
group accounts either way.
